title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Applications: Tier Requirements and the Bank's Decision
content:
**Decision standard.** An application for Ridgeline Consumer Credit names exactly one tier and is approved only when the applicant meets every entry requirement of that tier: a credit score at or above the tier's minimum credit score, an age at or above the tier's minimum applicant age, and a stated annual income at or above the tier's minimum annual income. Otherwise the application is declined.

**After a decline.** The bank never substitutes a lower tier on the same application; the applicant may submit a new application for another tier after a decline.

**On approval.** The bank assigns a credit line (revolving card) or loan amount (Ridgeline Project Loan) between the tier's lowest and highest line, subject to the combined exposure limit across the customer's accounts, and sets the day of the month on which statements close. The account moves from applied to active and records its opening date, the credit line or loan amount, the last four digits of the new account number and the statement closing day.

**Project Loan draw period.** For a Ridgeline Project Loan the draw period end date is the opening date plus the tier's draw period in calendar months, on the same day of the month, or on the last day of that month when that day does not exist. A revolving card has no draw period end date.

**Charges and autopay.** No tier charges an annual fee and no tier charges a prepayment penalty. An autopay option chosen on the application must be one of the tier's autopay options.

**Who decides.** Approval and decline are decisions of the issuing bank recorded by the system. Ridgeline Customer Care may submit an application on the applicant's behalf but never approves or declines one. A declined application never becomes an account.

## Requirement check (hypothetical applicant against hypothetical tier figures)

| Requirement | Tier figure | Applicant | Met? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Credit score | 680 | 680 | Yes (at the figure) |
| Age | 18 | 24 | Yes |
| Stated annual income | 30000.00 | 29500.00 | No |

One requirement unmet: the application is declined; the applicant may apply again for a different tier.

## Draw period end dates (hypothetical openings, 6-month draw period)

| Opening date | Draw period end date |
|---|---|
| 15 March | 15 September |
| 31 August | 28 February (29 February in a leap year) |
